run_entry_dispatch_source.meaning: R7 is the 32-bit Run dispatch flag word loaded from the first word of the caller-supplied descriptor

proven_execution_consequence: Within one Run invocation, when both R7 bit 4 and bit 5 are set and the selected cases succeed, GreenInterpolationWithCo executes first, returns to 0xffa107fa, and control later reaches the bit-5 ASMRedBlueInterpolation1 selector. This ordering is proven by selector and resume CFG edges, not inferred from case-body address order.
remaining_caveat: This does not yet prove that production callers set bits 4 and 5 simultaneously, nor does it prove global ordering if separate Run invocations are used.
next_gate: Trace exact direct/indirect callers of Run, recover the R0 descriptor/flag-word construction, and determine whether bits 4 and 5 coexist in production command masks or are scheduled in separate invocations.
